trend.label: Trend following
trend.blurb: Time-series momentum: is each market going up or down, and how strongly. The industry's core strategy, and the one the SG CTA index measures. Slow filters, vol-scaled positions, long and short.

carry.label: Carry
carry.blurb: The roll yield of the futures curve: long markets in backwardation, short markets in contango, annualised and vol-adjusted. Nearly uncorrelated with trend, and as good on its own over the long run.

relative.label: Relative value
relative.blurb: Cross-sectional ranking: which markets are strongest against their peers, not against their own past. Long the top, short the bottom, within an asset class or a sector, so the book is market-neutral by construction.

multi.label: Multi-strategy
multi.blurb: Combinations: trend and carry blended at the forecast level or as sleeves, with and without a risk-regime overlay. Where the diversification shows up as Sharpe.

premia.label: Risk premia
premia.blurb: Long every market at its vol-scaled size. The return for holding risk, with no view; the baseline every active strategy has to beat.

alt.label: Alternative factors
alt.blurb: Value, acceleration and skew: the rules from the literature that are weak, wrong-signed or fragile on this universe. Shown because the evidence is the point, not because they earn their place.

digital.label: Digital assets
digital.blurb: Relative momentum across the fifty most liquid crypto perpetuals, on a separate store and venue. A sleeve that does not clear its own statistical nulls yet; shown with that caveat.
